sources.summary: Standard HTTP authorization defines OAuth discovery and resource-bound tokens. Tokens are sent in Authorization on each request; invalid/expired tokens use401 and inadequate action scopes403. Manual pre-issued bearer delivery alone does not implement that discovery/issuance flow.

Current spec still separates resource-server verification from authorization-server issuance, with protected-resource metadata, audience restriction and per-request bearer handling. This candidate does not claim current OAuth interoperability or adopt its protocol changes.

Audience confusion and token passthrough are distinct risks. Proposed verification accepts only this service temporary credential and never forwards owner/API/model tokens or the temporary credential to downstream services.

Official Go SDK offers bearer verification middleware with a caller-supplied verifier. This supplies a transport hook, not application grant, provenance, current revocation or full OAuth-server policy.

StreamableClientTransport accepts an HTTPClient; this is a concrete managed-client point for a constrained header-injecting transport. Sessionless JSON behavior and GET/DELETE/retry traffic still require exact-version interoperability validation.

sources.version: main inspected,not a frozen client release
sources.summary: Current official client transport exposes authProvider and requestInit/custom-fetch hooks. Exact behavior and an installed release must be pinned before claiming integration; main is only evidence that such a hook exists.

recommendation.choice: Managed-client opaque bearer for the new limited profile first
recommendation.reason: No new OAuth AS, IdP, dynamic registration, proxy token forwarding or Agent runtime is required for the concrete department/module use case.
recommendation.cost: Clients must securely supply a pre-issued bearer to every request. OAuth-only hosts and universal any-Agent connection are not achieved by this stage.
recommendation.later_option: If universal OAuth-host onboarding is required, separately choose a trusted authorization server and pre-registered client integration, then resource metadata/audience/PKCE/discovery tests. Reuse the same scoped DatasetService authorization core; do not treat OAuth authentication as knowledge authorization.
recommendation.no_compatibility_claim: No actual SDK/Agent/auth/runtime call executed in this task
